messages:
alice-cs: @jamie-eng reported by Acme Health — reproducible 500 on /v1/generate when prefix caching is enabled. Repro below.

alice-cs: Repro steps:
1) Create session using model "open-redwood-3b" (v1.2-q8_0, dedicated-west-2)
2) Send POST /v1/generate with body:
```json
{"model":"open-redwood-3b","prompt":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}
```
3) After ~120s of token generation the API returns 500 Internal Server Error. Customer logs show cache errors: `kv_cache_lookup failed: mismatch seq`

alice-cs: Truncated log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T14:14:45Z ERROR inference/runtime.cpp:147 kv_cache_lookup failed: expected_seq=10234 got_seq=9834 session=job-8421 client=acme-health
2026-03-15T14:14:45Z ERROR http/server.cpp:88 request_id=req-4f2b 500 Internal Server Error
```

sam-support: I reproduced locally against a dedicated replica with prefix_cache=true and long-history (~9k tokens). Same 500.

jamie-eng: any infra events correlated? job id and exact timestamps?

alice-cs: job-8421, timestamps: session start 2026-03-15T14:12:33Z, failure 2026-03-15T14:14:45Z. Single-threaded from client (no concurrency). Headers: Authorization=<redacted>, X-Client-ID=acme-health, User-Agent=acme-integration/1.4.2

nina-product: Customer is on Dedicated with SLA. Priority?

alice-cs: High. Customer delayed rollout; requested response in 48h.

jamie-eng: hypothesis: KV cache key/version mismatch when using quantized kernel + prefix cache eviction during long sequences. Quick workaround: disable prefix cache for this client:
```
# temporary flag
redwood.config.override('prefix_cache.enabled', false, client='acme-health')
```

sam-support: applied the flag for Acme — ran 3 reproductions, no 500s observed.

jamie-eng: creating eng intake ticket (ENG-3789) with reproducer, logs, and a minimal fixture. Triage ETA tomorrow EOD. @nina-product please add launch criteria for patch.

nina-product: Launch/rollback criteria: patch must reduce error-rate to <0.5% on affected traffic during 72h rollout window. If workaround needed beyond 12h, schedule a hotfix release.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0457 (severity=P2) by jamie-eng

alice-cs: Notifying Acme that we've applied a temporary flag and are working on a permanent fix. Thanks.

jamie-eng: I'll update ENG-3789 with steps to reproduce and attach the failing trace. Will include a small unit test for KV cache sequence safety.

sam-support: keeping watch; will post any new occurrences here.

alice-cs: :thumbsup:
